name: Atlas Project Assistant
description: Declarative agent scoped to the Project Atlas site (synthetic fixture card). The agent id in the URL path is opaque: keep it whole, including its prefix and dot.

skills.name: Ask about my work
skills.description: Answers questions grounded in the signed-in user's Microsoft 365 content (mail, files, meetings, chats) with citations.
examples: Summarize the status of Project Atlas and cite the sources.
What did I agree to in yesterday's design sync?
